subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt memory.recall, memory.capture, memory.compaction, memory.dreaming, and memory.userModel—with per-agent overrides and hook-level role gating—as the permanent core plugin/configuration contract?
rationale: This is a long-lived public configuration and plugin SDK commitment; correctness tests cannot decide whether the five-role taxonomy and per-agent semantics are the intended product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the typed role contract
options.body: Approve the role taxonomy in principle, then require the runtime migration repair and exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow the first surface
options.body: Limit the initial contract to roles with complete existing runtime semantics and defer unsupported role or per-agent behavior.

options.title: Pause the architecture
options.body: Keep the canonical issue open and decline this branch until a different composition model is chosen.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the typed role contract
recommendation.body: Approve the role taxonomy in principle, then require the runtime migration repair and exact-head compatibility proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current main history and the permanent core API decision make steipete the strongest routing candidate.
